subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

It has been / raining intermittently / since two days.
solution:
The erroneous part is **"since two days"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the usage of "since" is incorrect instead of this we need to use "for"
 
• "Since" is used to show points in time whereas "for" is used to show periods of time.
 
• Let's see some examples-
 
 
• It has been raining since 8 a.m.
 
• It has been raining for 8 hours.
 
 

**Hence, the correct sentence is-** *It has been raining intermittently** for two days*****.**
